events.speaker: customer
events.text: My washing machine is in the utility closet, and water is actively dripping from the inlet hose right now. I put a towel down but it is getting wet.

events.speaker: intake_agent
events.text: If you can do so safely, you may shut off the nearby water valve. Are you able to reach it without moving the appliance?

events.speaker: customer
events.text: I shut the supply valve. The floor is drying, and the hose is not leaking now, so there has been no new water since I turned it off.

events.speaker: intake_agent
events.text: When could someone come to inspect the hose? The office will confirm an exact appointment after checking the technician schedule.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: Saturday morning should work for me. If anything changes, I will call the office as soon as I know.

events.speaker: intake_agent
events.text: Would you like a quote before any repair begins, or are you comfortable deciding after the technician inspects it?

events.speaker: customer
events.text: No quote is needed. Please call me before starting the repair so I can confirm after hearing what the technician finds.

events.speaker: intake_agent
events.text: I will note that the water has stopped for now and that you want a call before work begins.
